data.one_liner: Minimalistic Flutter widgets inspired by shadcn/ui for desktop and touch devices.
data.what_it_does: Forui is a Flutter UI library that provides over 50 minimalistic, customizable widgets inspired by shadcn/ui. It includes comprehensive layout, form, data presentation, tile, navigation, feedback, overlay, and foundation components, with support for I10n and Flutter Hooks.
use_when: You want a modern, minimalistic design system inspired by shadcn/ui for your Flutter app
You need a comprehensive set of pre-built custom widgets for desktop and touch devices
You want to use an interactive theme builder or CLI to generate styling boilerplate
avoid_when: Your project strictly follows standard Material Design or Cupertino style guidelines
You are using a Flutter version older than 3.50.0
strengths: Interactive theme builder and CLI support for generating themes
First-class Flutter Hooks integration via forui_hooks
Active maintenance and tested against Flutter changes
weaknesses: Specific design aesthetic (shadcn/ui inspired) which may require overrides to match other design languages
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.50.0+ and Dart 3.14.0+. Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want native Material Design components instead of a shadcn/ui inspired style kit.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want native Apple Cupertino style components.
